Subject: Update on Your Department’s Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase. After careful review, we have decided not to approve the request at this time, as the current justification does not align with the company’s immediate financial strategy.

However, we are open to reconsidering this in the future. If you would like to resubmit, please provide a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. This additional context will help us better evaluate the potential impact on our goals.

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

The name of the home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.
